region_note: Units / reaches intersecting this box are kept (Thailand + 0.5 deg). Upstream areas outside it (e.g. upper Mekong / Salween) are not stored; catchments report their coverage.

catchment_levels._comment: Which HydroBASINS level is reported as basin / sub_basin / local catchment. Median unit size over Thailand: level 5 ~13,800 km2, level 7 ~1,600 km2 (close to the ~1,450 km2 average of the national sub-basins), level 12 ~140 km2.
